reason: I can get the same kind of resume tips and placement practice free on YouTube and GeeksforGeeks, and I'm short on money and time. I would use the free resume check, but I would not pay for something I have not seen actually get me a job.
objection: That the paid part is just a chatbot that gives hints, which I can get from free forums and videos, and that a plan built from what I have proven is still generic advice in the end.
